## Summary

Describe the purpose of this change and the affected report pages, data, assets, or documentation.

## Validation

- [ ] The report opens without repair prompts.
- [ ] Affected pages, filters, and navigation were tested.
- [ ] Representative values were checked against the approved source.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or restricted exports are included.

## Collaboration

- [ ] The group was informed of the PBIX change or handoff.
- [ ] Contributor credit remains accurate.
- [ ] At least one group member reviewed material report changes.
